neighborhoods.name: Ashby Fields
neighborhoods.notes: expanding residential area with newer housing stock

property_mix.notable: Daventry has significant post-war expansion with modern developments; industrial heritage influences some older areas.

locksmith_relevant: Modern Ashby Fields new-builds often feature contemporary composite doors and digital locks requiring specialist knowledge.
Post-war semi-detached stock dominates, typically with standard mortice locks prone to wear in ageing properties.
Interwar Middlemore properties may contain original period locks and listed building restrictions affecting replacement options.
